subject: Evaluation playbook & deployment lane for Nimbus Health - next steps
messages:
From: Nancy Zhou <nancy.zhou@nimbushealth.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Tony Alvarez <tony.alvarez@nimbushealth.com>
Date: 2027-05-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: MAP draft and hosting question for evaluation

Hi Lauren,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Attaching our draft Mutual Action Plan (Nimbus_MAP_v1.xlsx) — high level asks below. We need a recommendation from Redwood on which deployment lane (Hosted / Dedicated / Private) makes the most sense for our pilot and how region selection (EU vs US) will impact timelines / procurement.

Key constraints:
- PHI-adjacent workflows (patient summaries), must stay in EU for pilot.
- Need 99.9% soft SLO and sub-200ms p95 for chat flows during demos.
- Budget sensitivity: prefer predictable unit cost over absolute lowest cost.

Target decision date: 2027-05-24 so procurement can start. Can your team propose a recommended lane + a short evaluation plan that maps to our MAP milestones? Also include any paperwork we should prep for procurement (security questionnaire, SOC2 evidence).

Attachments: Nimbus_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)

— Nancy
Director, Digital Products
Nimbus Health
From: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Nancy Zhou <nancy.zhou@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, camila_reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-18T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft and hosting question for evaluation

Nancy — thanks for the clear ask and the MAP. I reviewed the constraints; good news is we can support your EU residency requirement for the pilot. High-level recommendation: run the pilot on Redwood Dedicated in our eu-west region (predictable throughput and isolation for PHI-adjacent data) with a fallback to Hosted for non-critical demo traffic during cutover.

Proposed evaluation plan (short):
- Day 0–7: Security baseline (we'll send the SOC2 packet + Nimbus_Security_Q_A.pdf).
- Week 2: Performance spike test (we'll run a sandbox load test to validate p95 latency <200ms with representative prompts).
- Week 3: Canary in eu-west with a 10% production-slice for 3 days.
- Week 4: Decision & procurement kickoff — if performance and cost look good, commit to Dedicated reserve for Q3.

I'll attach a short runbook draft (deployment-runbook-draft.md) and loop Rishi and Camila to confirm the performance targets and pricing band. Can we set a 30-minute sync tomorrow 10:00 AM CEST to walk through the MAP and procurement asks?

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, camila_reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-18T13:40:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Nimbus MAP - recommended lane

Team — forwarding Nimbus MAP and my note to Nancy. Quick take: they need EU residency and predictable SLOs, so Dedicated (eu-west) aligns best. Items to confirm before we send formal recommendation:
- Target sustained QPS and expected burst patterns for demo windows (ask Nancy for sample traces).
- Minimum commit we can offer that still meets their budget profile (we want to propose a 3-month reserved baseline + burst).
- Security deliverables: confirm the latest SOC2 packet and prepare a redacted architecture diagram showing VPC peering / ingress controls.

Ben — can you estimate the number of GPUs and expected token cost for a 3-month pilot given target p95 ~200ms? Rishi / Camila — any constraints on canary rollout timing for EU?

Thanks,
Lauren
From: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, camila_reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-19T10:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: Nimbus MAP - recommended lane

Lauren — quick estimates and feasibility:
- Recommendation: Dedicated eu-west with a Hosted fallback. Dedicated gives isolation and consistent latency; EU region keeps data locality for PHI-adjacent work.
- Canary plan: 10% traffic slice for 72 hours, monitor p95 and error budget; rollback if >5% error spike or p95 >250ms sustained for 30m.
- Sizing: for their stated demo profile (peak 80 QPS bursts for ~15 minutes, baseline 5–8 QPS), start with 4x A100-equivalent nodes with auto-burst to 6 for spikes. Cost estimate attached in-line and as an export.

I've attached Nimbus_Security_Q_A.pdf (SOC2 snippets + cert page) and a short cost sketch. If procurement needs a contract redline window, propose 30 days.

— Rishi
Principal Solutions Architect
From: Nancy Zhou <nancy.zhou@nimbushealth.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Tony Alvarez <tony.alvarez@nimbushealth.com>, camila_reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-20T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation playbook & deployment lane for Nimbus Health - next steps

Lauren / team — thanks, this is exactly the level of detail we need. We reviewed the recommendation internally and are aligned to proceed with Dedicated in eu-west. A few notes:

- Timeline: we agree to the 4-week cadence in your plan. Decision & procurement kickoff on 2027-05-24.
- Security: thanks for the SOC2 packet; procurement will follow up with a short info request early next week.
- Pricing: we'll review Rishi's cost sketch and revert with a target commit by Friday.

Attached: signed MAP cover page (we'll upload the completed MAP to your Drive link) and our procurement intake template. Can we lock a technical kickoff for 2027-05-26?

Thanks — Nancy
Director, Digital Products
Nimbus Health
Attachments: Nimbus_MAP_v1.xlsx (updated), procurement-intake.docx
